behaviour_signature.air_mean_note: the triad spread is measured across the three chamber-air positions only; the hot-side surface is never part of it

air_separation.band_basis: a factor-of-two screen around one session's own maximum spread, chosen to raise a flag for inspection. It is not a repeat tolerance and not a movement threshold: with one baseline session there is no measured run-to-run spread to build one from, and A-W14-04 leaves the real number to Member B
air_separation.meaning_if_outside: the mutual spread of the three air probes left the band the baseline session shows. Because that band comes from one run's within-session drift, this is a flag to look, not a measurement of movement: it also fires if the chamber started at a different load or the door was left cracked.

air_triad_direction.meaning_if_mismatched: one of the three chamber-air channels stopped falling while driven, so that tip is no longer sampling the air volume the other two agree about - the most likely causes are a probe that moved, became coupled to a surface, or became electrically stale while the value held.

channel_rank_order.meaning_if_mismatched: the ordering of the channels by level flipped. Positions in a stratified chamber set the ordering, so a persistent flip with everything else unchanged is the pattern a probe swap or a probe that moved a shelf over would leave.

hot_side_channel.meaning_if_mismatched: the channel that rises while the bridge is driven is no longer the slot the record calls TEC hot side: either the hot-side probe left the stack, an air probe is now touching the stack or a rack, or the 1-Wire slots were re-mapped at the connector. Any of these invalidates the air/hot split every W07 statistic is built on.

level_offset_c.meaning_if_large: the absolute levels sit outside the baseline session's own drift band. That is expected whenever start conditions differ, so on its own it says nothing about position; it only matters together with a direction or separation change.
